messages.text: BL-1698 🎵 in progress — The local parcel driver is safe to live with - a restart mid-parcel resumes from the recorded step with the spec writable again, an escalated parcel is released by the human's answer (one more fix request) or an operator release (complete or retry), a QA merge-up note or non-forwarding reverse copy is merged and completed with no model turn, any other note is passed to the human and completed, and babysitterd stops nudging driver seats
